sentences.text: This extinct bird had skull and leg structures similar to today's potoos.
It featured a slender beak, an exceptionally broad mouth, and large wings that were smaller than those of modern relatives.
Scientists have recovered complete skeletons and numerous well-preserved skulls.
Fossil remains were discovered in the Messel pit in Germany.
Subsequent research reclassified Paraprefica into the family Nyctibiidae and order Caprimulgiformes based on unique anatomical characteristics.
Paraprefica was an extinct potoo that lived during the Middle Eocene, approximately 48 million years ago.
The species existed between 48.07 and 41.03 million years ago during the Lutetian stage.
It is debated whether the ancestors of potoos were once cosmopolitan or originally Eurasian, given that Paraprefica fossils are found in Germany while modern species are restricted to the Americas.
